transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I came in because I’m not handling things well lately. Ever since they changed my hours at the warehouse and brought in this new inventory system, I feel like I’m just falling apart. I’ve been missing shifts, missing things at church, snapping at my family… some mornings I’m sitting there with my work boots on and I don’t even know if I can make myself go in.
Have you been feeling unusually anxious or on edge lately?

Yes. I’ve been really on edge since they changed my hours at the warehouse and started that new inventory system. I feel like I’m falling apart some days—missing shifts, missing church commitments, snapping at my family. Some mornings I’m just sitting there in my work boots, wondering if I can even face going in.
Have you been feeling sad or down most of the time lately?
I don’t know if I’d say sad most of the time. I’m worn down and discouraged, but I haven’t really thought of it as being sad all day or anything.
Do you find yourself worrying about things that are coming up, like your work shifts or other responsibilities?

Yes, I do. I worry a lot about my shifts now—whether I’m going to mess up with that new inventory system, or whether I can even make myself go in. And then I start thinking about the church things I’ve missed and how I’m acting at home, and it just feels like everything’s piling up. Some mornings I’m sitting there with my boots on, stuck, wondering if I can face the place at all.
Have you experienced any episodes where you suddenly felt intense fear or discomfort that reached a peak within minutes?
No, I don’t think so. I get worked up and tense, but I can’t say I’ve had something come on all at once like that and peak in a few minutes.
Have you been enjoying things you usually like to do?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t paid much attention to whether I’m enjoying things or not. I guess I’ve just been getting through the day.
Are you finding pleasure in the things you usually enjoy?
I’m not sure, honestly. I haven’t really been paying attention to whether I’m enjoying things. Mostly I just feel like I’m getting through what I have to do.
Are there things that you used to enjoy doing that you no longer find pleasure in?
I don’t really know. I haven’t been thinking about it that clearly. I can’t point to something and say I definitely don’t enjoy it anymore. I’ve mostly just been going along day to day.
Do you feel like you've lost interest in activities that you used to like?

I’m not sure I’d say I’ve lost interest, exactly. I just haven’t really been thinking about it that way. I still do things, but I don’t know if I’m enjoying them like before or just doing them out of habit.
Have you noticed any change in your weight recently?
I haven’t really noticed any change in my weight, no. I don’t check it that closely, but nothing’s stood out to me.
Do you find that you worry about things even when there's no obvious reason to worry?
I don’t know. I do worry, but I’m not sure it’s for no reason. Usually there’s something on my mind, even if I can’t always sort it out clearly.
Do you often find yourself worrying about things even when everything seems to be going okay?
I’m not really sure. I mean, I do get worried, but it’s hard for me to tell if things are actually okay or if I’m just waiting for something to go wrong.
Do you find yourself worrying about things more days than not?
I’m not sure I can say “more days than not.” I do worry, but I haven’t really kept track of how often it is. Some days it’s there more than others.
Are there things you used to enjoy that you no longer look forward to?
I’m not really sure. I mean, I still do some of the same things, but I haven’t paid close attention to whether I look forward to them like I used to.
Do you feel like you've been able to take pleasure in activities you're currently doing?
I’m not sure, honestly. I still do things, but I don’t really pay attention to whether I’m enjoying them in the moment. Sometimes I just get through them.
Do you worry about things almost every day?
I don’t know if it’s almost every day. I do worry, but I haven’t really been counting it like that. Some days it’s on my mind, some days not as much.
Do you feel like you're unable to experience pleasure from activities?
I’m not sure I’d say unable. I don’t really think about it that way. I do things, but I guess I haven’t noticed clearly whether I’m getting pleasure from them or just doing them.
Do you feel like you're unable to enjoy things that you used to enjoy?

I’m not really sure. I can’t say for certain that I’m unable to enjoy them. I just haven’t been paying close attention to it, I guess. Some things I still do, but whether I’m really enjoying them like before… I don’t know.
Do you feel like you've lost the ability to feel pleasure in things?
I’m not sure I’d put it that strongly. I haven’t really noticed it as a complete loss of pleasure. I just… I don’t know, I haven’t been thinking about it in those terms.
Do you feel like you've lost interest in things you used to find pleasurable?
I don’t really know. I haven’t noticed a clear loss of interest, exactly. I still do some of the same things, but I’m not sure if I feel the same about them as I used to.
